title: Message queue backlog growing
symptoms: Queue orders has 50000 messages ready and growing. Consumer lag increasing on topic events. Messages are produced faster than they are consumed.
root_cause: Consumers are down, stuck on a poison message, or too few for the current traffic.
impact: Delayed processing: orders, emails or events arrive late. The broker may run out of disk.
fix_steps: Check that consumer processes are running and connected.
Look for a message that keeps failing and move it to a dead-letter queue.
Scale up the number of consumers.
prevention: Alert on consumer lag, use dead-letter queues, and autoscale consumers on queue depth.
